versos.hebraico: וַיִּסַּ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א בְּאֵ֣רָה שָּׁ֑בַע וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח זְבָחִ֔ים לֵאלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֥יו יִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
controles.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer–sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
controles.livre: E partiu-se Israel com tudo o que tinha, e veio a Berseba, e ofereceu sacrifícios ao Deus de seu pai Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּמַרְאֹ֣ת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֣ב׀ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!”   He said, “Here I am.”
controles.kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
controles.livre: E falou Deus a Israel em visões de noite, e disse: Jacó, Jacó. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י הָאֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֑יךָ אַל־תִּירָא֙ מֵרְדָ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יְמָה כִּֽי־לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֥ שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
controles.kjv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
controles.livre: E disse: Eu sou Deus, o Deus de teu pai; não temas de descer ao Egito, porque eu te farei ali em grande nação.

versos.hebraico: אָנֹכִ֗י אֵרֵ֤ד עִמְּךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַֽעַלְךָ֣ גַם־עָלֹ֑ה וְיוֹסֵ֕ף יָשִׁ֥ית יָד֖וֹ עַל־עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”
controles.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
controles.livre: Eu descerei contigo ao Egito, e eu também te farei voltar; e José porá sua mão sobre teus olhos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥קָם יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם בָּעֲגָל֕וֹת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח פַּרְעֹ֖ה לָשֵׂ֥את אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
controles.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
controles.livre: E levantou-se Jacó de Berseba; e tomaram os filhos de Israel a seu pai Jacó, e a seus filhos, e a suas mulheres, nos carros que Faraó havia enviado para levá-lo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֶת־רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽכְשׁוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְכָל־זַרְע֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his seed with him,
controles.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
controles.livre: E tomaram seus gados, e sua riqueza que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã, e vieram-se ao Egito, Jacó, e toda sua descendência consigo;

versos.hebraico: בָּנָ֞יו וּבְנֵ֤י בָנָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ בְּנֹתָ֛יו וּבְנ֥וֹת בָּנָ֖יו וְכָל־זַרְע֑וֹ הֵבִ֥יא אִתּ֖וֹ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃ס

controles.web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his seed with him into Egypt.
controles.kjv: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
controles.livre: Seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos consigo; suas filhas, e as filhas de seus filhos, e a toda sua descendência trouxe consigo ao Egito.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמ֧וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַבָּאִ֥ים מִצְרַ֖יְמָה יַעֲקֹ֣ב וּבָנָ֑יו בְּכֹ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵֽן׃

controles.web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que entraram no Egito, Jacó e seus filhos: Rúben, o primogênito de Jacó.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י רְאוּבֵ֑ן חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּפַלּ֖וּא וְחֶצְר֥וֹן וְכַרְמִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Rúben: Enoque, e Palu, e Hezrom, e Carmi.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן יְמוּאֵ֧ל וְיָמִ֛ין וְאֹ֖הַד וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֑חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽית׃

controles.web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, e Jamim, e Oade, e Jaquim, e Zoar, e Saul, filho da cananeia.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Levi: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֧ר וְאוֹנָ֛ן וְשֵׁלָ֖ה וָפֶ֣רֶץ וָזָ֑רַח וַיָּ֨מָת עֵ֤ר וְאוֹנָן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְחָמֽוּל׃

controles.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Judá: Er, e Onã, e Selá, e Perez, e Zerá: mas Er e Onã, morreram na terra de Canaã. E os filhos de Perez foram Hezrom e Hamul.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר תּוֹלָ֥ע וּפֻוָּ֖ה וְי֥וֹב וְשִׁמְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Issacar: Tola, e Puva, e Jó, e Sinrom.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י זְבוּלֻ֑ן סֶ֥רֶד וְאֵל֖וֹן וְיַחְלְאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Zebulom: Serede e Elom, e Jaleel.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָֽלְדָ֤ה לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּפַדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֑וֹ כָּל־נֶ֧פֶשׁ בָּנָ֛יו וּבְנוֹתָ֖יו שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֹֽשׁ׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
controles.kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan–aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Lia, os que deu a Jacó em Padã-Arã, e além de sua filha Diná: trinta e três as almas todas de seus filhos e filhas.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד צִפְי֥וֹן וְחַגִּ֖י שׁוּנִ֣י וְאֶצְבֹּ֑ן עֵרִ֥י וַֽאֲרוֹדִ֖י וְאַרְאֵלִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Gade: Zifiom, e Hagi, e Suni, e Ezbom, e Eri, e Arodi, e Areli.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֣רַח אֲחֹתָ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Aser: Imna, e Isva, e Isvi y Berias, e Sera, irmã deles. Os filhos de Berias: Héber, e Malquiel.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י זִלְפָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְלֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֑וֹ וַתֵּ֤לֶד אֶת־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Zilpa, a que Labão deu a sua filha Lia, e deu estes a Jacó; todas dezesseis almas.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֤י רָחֵל֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃

controles.web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
controles.kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Raquel, mulher de Jacó: José e Benjamim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְיוֹסֵף֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹ֑ן אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
controles.kjv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti–pherah priest of On bare unto him.
controles.livre: E nasceram a José na terra do Egito Manassés e Efraim, os que lhe deu Azenate, filha Potífera, sacerdote de Om.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֤לַע וָבֶ֨כֶר֙ וְאַשְׁבֵּ֔ל גֵּרָ֥א וְנַעֲמָ֖ן אֵחִ֣י וָרֹ֑אשׁ מֻפִּ֥ים וְחֻפִּ֖ים וָאָֽרְדְּ׃

controles.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Benjamim foram Belá, e Bequer e Asbel, e Gera, e Naamã, e Eí, e Rôs e Mupim, e Hupim, e Arde.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖ד לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Raquel, que nasceram a Jacó: ao todo, catorze almas.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי־דָ֖ן חֻשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: The son of Dan: Hushim.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Dã: Husim.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י נַפְתָּלִ֑י יַחְצְאֵ֥ל וְגוּנִ֖י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשִׁלֵּֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Naftali: Jazeel, e Guni, e Jezer, e Silém.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן לָבָ֖ן לְרָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֑וֹ וַתֵּ֧לֶד אֶת־אֵ֛לֶּה לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב כָּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ שִׁבְעָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Bila, a que deu Labão a Raquel sua filha, e ela deu à luz estes a Jacó; todas sete almas.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֠נֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָ֨ה לְיַעֲקֹ֤ב מִצְרַ֨יְמָה֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִלְּבַ֖ד נְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹ֑ב כָּל־נֶ֖פֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָשֵֽׁשׁ׃

controles.web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct descendants, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
controles.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
controles.livre: Todas as pessoas que vieram com Jacó ao Egito, procedentes de seus lombos, sem as mulheres dos filhos de Jacó, todas as pessoas foram sessenta e seis.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־יֻלַּד־ל֥וֹ בְמִצְרַ֖יִם נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׁנָ֑יִם כָּל־הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ לְבֵֽית־יַעֲקֹ֛ב הַבָּ֥אָה מִצְרַ֖יְמָה שִׁבְעִֽים׃פ

controles.web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
controles.livre: E os filhos de José, que lhe nasceram no Egito, duas pessoas. Todas as almas da casa de Jacó, que entraram no Egito, foram setenta.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־יְהוּדָ֞ה שָׁלַ֤ח לְפָנָיו֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף לְהוֹרֹ֥ת לְפָנָ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה גֹּֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
controles.kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
controles.livre: E enviou a Judá adiante de si a José, para que lhe viesse a ver a Gósen; e chegaram à terra de Gósen.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאְסֹ֤ר יוֹסֵף֙ מֶרְכַּבְתּ֔וֹ וַיַּ֛עַל לִקְרַֽאת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אָבִ֖יו גֹּ֑שְׁנָה וַיֵּרָ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וַיִּפֹּל֙ עַל־צַוָּארָ֔יו וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל־צַוָּארָ֖יו עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
controles.kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
controles.livre: E José preparou seu carro e veio a receber a Israel seu pai a Gósen; e se manifestou a ele, e lançou-se sobre seu pescoço, e chorou sobre seu pescoço bastante.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־יוֹסֵ֖ף אָמ֣וּתָה הַפָּ֑עַם אַחֲרֵי֙ רְאוֹתִ֣י אֶת־פָּנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י עוֹדְךָ֖ חָֽי׃

controles.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
controles.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
controles.livre: Então Israel disse a José: Morra eu agora, já que vi teu rosto, pois ainda vives.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹסֵ֤ף אֶל־אֶחָיו֙ וְאֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאֹֽמְרָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אַחַ֧י וּבֵית־אָבִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנַ֖עַן בָּ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃

controles.web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
controles.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
controles.livre: E José disse a seus irmãos, e à casa de seu pai: Subirei e farei saber a Faraó, e lhe direi: Meus irmãos e a casa de meu pai, que estavam na terra de Canaã, vieram a mim;

versos.hebraico: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ רֹ֣עֵי צֹ֔אן כִּֽי־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הָי֑וּ וְצֹאנָ֧ם וּבְקָרָ֛ם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם הֵבִֽיאוּ׃

controles.web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
controles.kjv: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
controles.livre: E os homens são pastores de ovelhas, porque são homens criadores de gado: e trouxeram suas ovelhas e suas vacas, e tudo o que tinham.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּֽי־יִקְרָ֥א לָכֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְאָמַ֖ר מַה־מַּעֲשֵׂיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
controles.livre: E quando Faraó vos chamar e disser: qual é vosso ofício?

versos.hebraico: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִקְנֶ֜ה הָי֤וּ עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ מִנְּעוּרֵ֣ינוּ וְעַד־עַ֔תָּה גַּם־אֲנַ֖חְנוּ גַּם־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בַּעֲב֗וּר תֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ גֹּ֔שֶׁן כִּֽי־תוֹעֲבַ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם כָּל־רֹ֥עֵה צֹֽאן׃

controles.web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
controles.kjv: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
controles.livre: Então direis: Homens de criação de gado foram teus servos desde nossa juventude até agora, nós e nossos pais; a fim que moreis na terra de Gósen, porque os egípcios abominam todo pastor de ovelhas.
